children: AleAnna appointed Glen Cayley to its board and named him to its Audit and Compensation committees, effective November 9, 2026.
Class III director; Audit Committee and Compensation Committee member
Appointed to the board and both committees
The board cited his extensive experience in upstream oil and gas exploration, development and operations.
40 years of global oil and gas experience; held senior roles at Shell EP and Royal Dutch Shell, including Vice President of Exploration Excellence.
Board term expires at the 2027 annual meeting; appointed to the Audit and Compensation committees.
Will receive the company’s standard compensation for non-employee directors.
